Variable: depends on whether you have already done the Roshamuul Quest missions and on luck with the bosses' drops

Earn the **Dream Warden** outfit and its two addons from the NPC {npc:Eruaran}, in Roshamuul. The base outfit requires four missions of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest|Roshamuul Quest}; addon 1 asks for a {item:Dream Warden Mask} from the Roshamuul Prison bosses and addon 2 for a {item:Dream Warden Claw}. At the end you also receive the achievement **Dream Warden**.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 250**: you will be dealing with the creatures of Roshamuul and the bosses of the Roshamuul Prison.
Access to {npc:Eruaran}: your server must have killed {creature:Gaz'haragoth} on the central mountain of Roshamuul.

Base outfit: the missions **A Cup of Tea**, **Ancient Dreams** and **Waters of Life** (from {npc:Morax}) and **Mend What's Broken** (from {npc:Dream Butterfly}) of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest|Roshamuul Quest}.
Addon 2 (claw): you must have addon 1 (mask) first.
for addon 2 (claw); obtained in Unrealized Dreams or from Gaz'haragoth
First of all, check that {npc:Eruaran} is already available on your server (he only appears after the server has defeated {creature:Gaz'haragoth} on the central mountain).
{creature:Gaz'haragoth} can drop both the {item:Dream Warden Mask} and the {item:Dream Warden Claw}.
The base outfit is given by {npc:Eruaran} after you complete four missions of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest|Roshamuul Quest}.
Complete the missions **A Cup of Tea**, **Ancient Dreams** and **Waters of Life** from {npc:Morax} (see the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest|Roshamuul Quest} guide).
Complete the mission **Mend What's Broken** from {npc:Dream Butterfly} (it is also part of the Roshamuul Quest).

Travel to **Roshamuul** from **Thais**: at the port, say {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Bluebear} (210 gp). The boat docks at the southern camp, in Lower Roshamuul, next to {npc:Captain Chelop}. Cross Guzzlemaw Valley to the **northeast** and go through the open wall into {wiki:Upper Roshamuul} (if you are a Roshamuul citizen, you can go directly to the Upper Roshamuul temple). {npc:Eruaran} is at the top of the central mountain, **east** of the depot.
Gap in the wall to Upper Roshamuul
With the four missions done, go to {npc:Eruaran} to receive the **Dream Warden** outfit.

Get a {item:Dream Warden Mask}. It drops from the bosses of the {wiki:Roshamuul Prison|Roshamuul Prison}: {creature:Gaz'haragoth}, {creature:Horadron}, {creature:Prince Drazzak}, {creature:Terofar} and {creature:Zavarash}. The entrance to the {wiki:Roshamuul Prison|Roshamuul Prison} is **south** of the Upper Roshamuul depot, west of the passage in the wall; the prison has 3 main floors and the bosses are further down. To leave, go back the same way to the surface.
The Roshamuul Prison bosses are very strong: go as a team and well prepared.
Map of the 1st floor of the Roshamuul Prison
Take the {item:Dream Warden Mask} to {npc:Eruaran} to receive the first addon.
You can only receive this addon after you have addon 1.
Get a {item:Dream Warden Claw}. You can get it from {item:Unrealized Dream|Unrealized Dreams} or as a drop from {creature:Gaz'haragoth}.
Take the {item:Dream Warden Claw} to {npc:Eruaran} to receive the second addon. With the complete outfit you also get the **Dream Warden** achievement.
Complete Dream Warden, with both addons (male)
Complete Dream Warden, with both addons (female)

Go back to the southern camp (from Upper Roshamuul cross Guzzlemaw Valley and the bridge to the **south** and go down the Lower Roshamuul ramp). Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}, next to the boat: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
